title: Ship a dependent with its blocker
when: When a release candidate carries an item whose closure or delivery edge waits on an item that has not shipped yet.
need: Release composition skips a carried item while its blocking edge is unmet and names the blocker in its skipped notice; the first later release after the blocker ships enrolls it automatically. A blocker that the same run enrolls, or that is already a member, ships with its dependent, so both enroll together. A blocker the run holds back holds back its own dependents too. Coordination-only and satisfied edges never delay enrollment. Do not add-item a skipped dependent by hand; read the notice and wait for the blocker's release. Co-scheduling admits the release; it does not satisfy the durable completion milestone or prove the correction is already deployed for QA. Confirm candidate containment and the required environment before retesting.
surface: Carried-member enrollment at deployment start and validate-composition; skipped-candidate notice; carried-membership refusal
gap: Proven in source and tests; a live release that enrolls a dependent with its same-run blocker is not yet recorded as evidence.
review: Pending live proof on a release that carries both items.
